title: trichospermum lanigerum
intro: Trichospermum lanigerum, commonly known as Woolly Trichospermum, is a plant species in the family Cunoniaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Trichospermum lanigerum include wound healing, antimicrobial resistance prevention, and the management of various diseases such as diabetes and hypertension. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
